detailed_description:
The target video is a realistic, passionate, highly cinematic 10-second motorcycle racing sequence on a professional racetrack under hard daylight, with hot asphalt shimmer, aggressive motion blur, and a tense, adrenaline-fueled tone. No dialogue, no subtitles, no on-screen text.
[Shot 1] A close-up from a low three-quarter angle beside the bike shows <Subject 1>, the racer in his full professional racing suit and full-face helmet, already mounted on <Subject 2>, the red futuristic sport bike with its yellow cowl emblem and glowing pink/red tail-light strip visible. He quickly leans forward, pressing his upper body tightly against the fuel tank, gripping the handlebars firmly with both hands, left foot planted on the footpeg. A tight insert holds on his right hand twisting the throttle as the engine barks to life, heat shimmer rising from the exhaust. The camera holds nearly static with a slight slow push-in on the twisting hand.
[Shot 2] At 00:02.000, the shot cuts to a low-angle ground-level view at tarmac level, the rear wheel of <Subject 2> filling the frame — the tire spinning rapidly, asphalt texture whipping past, a wisp of tire smoke curling up. The camera pulls into a high-speed tracking shot alongside the bike as it launches down the straight, background barriers and grandstands streaking into heavy motion blur, the red fairing and glowing tail light cutting through the blur.
[Shot 3] At 00:04.000, a side-tracking shot moves with the bike as it enters a corner: <Subject 1> leans dramatically with <Subject 2>, his knee extended outward and pressed downward, his head lowered and turned toward the curve ahead, arms steady on the handlebars, body and machine forming one smooth, sharp cornering line. At 00:05.500, the shot cuts to an extreme low-angle close-up at tarmac level: the thrilling instant of his knee skimming just above the ground, the tire edge gripping the asphalt, the lean angle at maximum, sunlight glinting off the coral fairing.
[Shot 4] At 00:07.000, exiting the turn, <Subject 1> quickly pulls his body weight back and straightens <Subject 2> upright. A final low side-tracking shot follows as he accelerates hard, the engine surging, the motorcycle racing past the camera and blurring out of frame at extreme speed, leaving only the empty track shimmering in the heat.
